why_trail.why: B1 is a real, deterministic Windows failure: the six assertions inherit their expectation from the platform (str(worktree)) while the derivation returns a normcase-folded path. The fix is confined to tests/test_spine_rail.py; production is frozen.

B1 reproduces mechanically: under ntpath the inherited expectation matches 0/12 comparisons across both derivation copies, while the constructed normcase(normpath(...)) form matches 12/12 under ntpath AND 12/12 under posixpath. The bug is invisible on this host precisely because normcase is the identity on POSIX.

All six comparisons now construct their expectation with os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(str(...))) through one local _derived_form helper, spelled exactly as the sibling table's _expected(). The remaining new assertions in this file are boolean, so B1's class is swept, not just its six instances. No production file changed.

The real test body, not a reconstruction: with the three lines reverted it FAILS under a folding normcase and PASSES on this host -- which is exactly why B1 was invisible here -- and as it now stands it passes under both. The revert asserts it applied, so the pre-fix red is real.

The test-body edit DID move the entity count, because the fix is a helper function rather than six inline expressions. The map delta is entity counts only (4736->4737, test_spine_rail 189->190), which is the bounded shape the handoff's scope grant anticipates.

Full suite green from a cleared cache (3159 passed, 6 skipped, 1164 subtests, 0 FAILED lines), the arithmetic unchanged from attempt 2 because attempt 3 adds a helper and not a test. Production is provably untouched by stat, hunk shape and mtime. The self-contained result covering attempts 1-3 is delivered, including the corrected scoped null: the test was guaranteed to fail on Windows, not merely untested there.

amendments.reason: The m1 harness reconstructs the six comparisons; it does not execute the test the blocker names. The handoff's Required Evidence 1 asks for the simulation run before and after against that test, so a gate that runs the REAL body under a folding normcase is added rather than accepting the reconstruction as a proxy.

The full suite is red on map freshness: the fix adds one module-level helper, so tests.test_spine_rail's entity count moved 4736->4737. The handoff puts map/ in scope for exactly this case and requires regeneration by the builder, so the rebuild gets its own gate with a hunk-shape check rather than being folded silently into the suite gate.
